fusions.name: Spore Shower
fusions.desc: Rains 5 spore clusters over the target area, spread apart, each dealing 5 damage with a 50% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on a target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Sodden Lob
fusions.desc: Lobs a sodden clump at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 28 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, ignoring resistances. The target is [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Fruiting Downpour
fusions.desc: Soaks a patch of ground up to 4 tiles away. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and every ally inside it.

fusions.name: Wet Season
fusions.desc: When you take non-fire damage, the healing you receive rises 30% for 8 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
